an3.25:1.1: 25 tayome bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an3.25:1.3: arukūpamacitto puggalo vijjūpamacitto puggalo vajirūpamacitto puggalo.
an3.25:1.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo
an3.25:1.6: appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an3.25:1.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave duṭṭhāruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyoso mattāya āsavaṃ deti
an3.25:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo
an3.25:1.9: appampi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti
an3.25:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.25:2.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave cakkhumā puriso rattandhakāratimisāya vijjantarikāya rūpāni passeyya
an3.25:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti … ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.25:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an3.25:3.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave vajirassa natthi kiñci abhejjaṃ maṇi vā pāsāṇo vā
an3.25:3.4: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā … upasampajja viharati
an3.25:3.6: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
